items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Roy Eldridge) does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Lew Terasi is made by the Interviewer, who says 'When you get around to Terasi's... I've got a story for you' and later 'playing at Lew Terasi's'. There is no statement from Eldridge confirming a personal relations

ctx.x: Well, see, I'll tell you one thing he had a habit of doing that I didn't like, you know. He would be swingin' like a dog, man. He'd build it up to where it's really going, and then he'd get to the middle, and he'd drop way down real soft, you know. And it would just cut your whole concentration and thinking, you know.
When you get around to Terasi's(?), I've got a story for you. Do you want me to tell it now?
